name: AI Provider ByteDance
description: ByteDance ModelArk provider for the AI module.
project_description: Registers ByteDance ModelArk (Volcengine/BytePlus) as an AI provider plugin for the drupal/ai framework. It exposes ByteDance's OpenAI-compatible chat, text-to-image and image-to-image endpoints to any Drupal subsystem that consumes the AI plugin system (Field UI, Actions, Views, custom code), reusing the AI module's OpenAI-style transport so no bespoke client code is needed. The provider ships model listings for Skylark, DeepSeek V3, Kimi K2, GPT-OSS and Seedream image models, maps ByteDance-specific parameters (thinking mode, reasoning effort, seed, watermark, sequential generation, prompt optimization) into the request payload, and translates ModelArk API errors into the AI module's exception types. The API key is stored through the Key module and the configuration form is gated behind the 'administer ai providers' permission.
